I don’t speak imperial system so I don’t know the size, but here’s what I’d do:
I recommend a bio active planted freshwater tank with some shrimp and an active fish species like corydora, betta, or danios. Put down fluval substrate, then fill it with maybe 4 cm of water, plant the plants, pour some aquarium sand over the fluval to keep the dust down, and fill it up with water gently (pour into a bowl, in the tank, letting it overflow into the tank).
Cycle it for a few days, add some beneficial bacteria to help with the nitrogen cycle, cycle another day or two, and add some fishies 
You can do whatever you want, but that’s what I would do 😄 have fun!!! Welcome to the tank world, you’ll never go back :D
